rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for apparel and clothes in general.

example.english: I bought some new clothes today.
example.traditional: 我今日買咗幾件新衣服。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 gei2 gin6 san1 ji1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when referring to everyday clothes specifically as shirts and trousers.

example.english: It’s cold today, so I wore thick clothes.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 dung3 ngo5 zoek3 zo2 hau5 saam1 fu3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the bedding and covers on a bed.

example.english: The clothes used as bed covers on the bed need washing.
example.traditional: 張床上面啲被鋪要洗喇。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 cong4 soeng6 min6 di1 pei5 pou1 jiu3 sai2 laa3
